title: Love, Death & Robots
description: Terrifying creatures, wicked surprises and dark comedy converge in this NSFW anthology of animated stories presented by Tim Miller and David Fincher.

episodes.title: S3-E3The Very Pulse of the Machine
S4-E2Close Encounters of the Mini Kind

episodes_data.title: Love, Death & Robots 1x1
episodes_data.description: In the underground world of "beastie" fights, Sonnie is unbeatable -- as long as she keeps her edge.

episodes_data.title: Love, Death & Robots 1x2
episodes_data.description: Long after the fall of humanity, three robots embark on a sightseeing tour of a post-apocalyptic city.

episodes_data.title: Love, Death & Robots 1x3
episodes_data.description: After seeing a brutal murder, a woman flees from the killer through the streets of a surreal city.

episodes_data.title: Love, Death & Robots 1x4
episodes_data.description: A community of farmers use their homemade mechs to defend their families from an alien invasion.

episodes_data.title: Love, Death & Robots 1x5
episodes_data.description: Unleashed by an archaeological dig, a bloodthirsty demon battles a team of mercenaries armed with... cats?

episodes_data.title: Love, Death & Robots 1x6
episodes_data.description: After scientists accidentally breed super-intelligent yogurt, it soon hungers for world domination.

episodes_data.title: Love, Death & Robots 1x7
episodes_data.description: Awakening after traveling light years off course, a ship's crew struggles to discover just how far they've come.

episodes_data.title: Love, Death & Robots 1x8
episodes_data.description: The son of a spirit hunter forges a bond with a shape-shifting huli jing.

episodes_data.title: Love, Death & Robots 1x9
episodes_data.description: Ugly Dave calls the garbage dump home, and he's not about to let some city slicker take it away from him.

episodes_data.title: Love, Death & Robots 1x10
episodes_data.description: Deep in Afghanistan, two Marines with supernatural powers face a threat from one of their own kind.

episodes_data.title: Love, Death & Robots 1x11
episodes_data.description: Stranded in orbit, an astronaut must choose between life and limb before her oxygen runs out.

episodes_data.title: Love, Death & Robots 1x12
episodes_data.description: After their car breaks down in the desert, two salesmen take a dreamlike voyage to the dawn of time.

episodes_data.title: Love, Death & Robots 1x13
episodes_data.description: After the drop-ship Lucky 13 lost two crews, no pilot would fly her... but rookies don't get a choice.

episodes_data.title: Love, Death & Robots 1x14
episodes_data.description: The renowned artist Zima recounts his mysterious past and rise to fame before unveiling his final work.

episodes_data.title: Love, Death & Robots 1x15
episodes_data.description: A gang of cyborg thieves stage a high-speed heist of a heavily armored convoy.

episodes_data.title: Love, Death & Robots 1x16
episodes_data.description: A young couple moves into an apartment and finds a lost civilization inside their antique freezer.

episodes_data.title: Love, Death & Robots 1x17
episodes_data.description: Want to see Hitler die in a variety of comically fantastic ways? Now you can. Welcome to Multiversity!

episodes_data.title: Love, Death & Robots 1x18
episodes_data.description: Elite units of the Red Army fight an unholy evil deep in the ancient forests of Siberia.

episodes_data.title: Love, Death & Robots 2x1
episodes_data.description: If your home-cleaning unit is attempting to murder you, please press 3.

episodes_data.title: Love, Death & Robots 2x2
episodes_data.description: Two brothers far from home join genetically "modded" locals in a deadly race.

episodes_data.title: Love, Death & Robots 2x3
episodes_data.description: A cop charged with fighting the scourge of overpopulation is haunted by the human toll of his work.

episodes_data.title: Love, Death & Robots 2x4
episodes_data.description: Every bounty hunter in the galaxy wants a piece of Snow.

episodes_data.title: Love, Death & Robots 2x5
episodes_data.description: During a journey across the prairie, a man becomes transfixed by distant, ghostly lights.

episodes_data.title: Love, Death & Robots 2x6
episodes_data.description: On Christmas Eve, two kids tiptoe downstairs to catch a glimpse of Santa. A twisted tale for adults only.

episodes_data.title: Love, Death & Robots 2x7
episodes_data.description: After crash-landing on a craggy planet, a pilot makes his way to shelter, only to face a threat within.

episodes_data.title: Love, Death & Robots 2x8
episodes_data.description: The body of a colossal young man washes ashore and becomes an object of fascination for the locals.

episodes_data.title: Love, Death & Robots 3x1
episodes_data.description: Three robots walk into the post-apocalypse… and take a whirlwind tour of humankind's last attempts to save itself.

episodes_data.title: Love, Death & Robots 3x2
episodes_data.description: Release the Thanapod! A ship’s crew member sailing an alien ocean strikes a deal with a ravenous monster of the deep.

episodes_data.title: Love, Death & Robots 3x3
episodes_data.description: When an exploratory mission to a Jovian moon ends in disaster, the lone survivor must begin a perilous but mind-expanding journey.

episodes_data.title: Love, Death & Robots 3x4
episodes_data.description: A bit of unholy cemetery sex ends badly, kicking off a worldwide zombie plague. It’s the cutest apocalypse you’ll ever see.

episodes_data.title: Love, Death & Robots 3x5
episodes_data.description: US Special Forces are trained to neutralize any threat — even a cybernetic killing machine created by the CIA. Their secret weapon? A sense of humor.

episodes_data.title: Love, Death & Robots 3x6
episodes_data.description: Two human scientists study the secrets of an ancient alien entity — but soon learn the horrible price of survival in a hostile universe.

episodes_data.title: Love, Death & Robots 3x7
episodes_data.description: Welcome to the Ratpocalypse! Farmer Mason knows he has a real pest problem when they start shooting back. Bloody hell!

episodes_data.title: Love, Death & Robots 3x8
episodes_data.description: Modern warfare meets elder gods. A special forces squad on a hostage rescue mission finds themselves trapped in a prison containing an age-old evil.

episodes_data.title: Love, Death & Robots 3x9
episodes_data.description: A deaf knight and a siren of myth become entwined in a deadly dance. A fatal attraction infused with blood, death and treasure.

episodes_data.title: Love, Death & Robots Season 4 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Turn up your stereo and tune into a Red Hot Chili Peppers concert that's unlike any other — with a few strings attached.

episodes_data.title: Love, Death & Robots Season 4 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: They came in peace. But when their first encounter with Earthlings goes awry, these extra-tiny extraterrestrials are ready for vengeance.

episodes_data.title: Love, Death & Robots Season 4 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: At the edge of the galaxy, a grieving woman dreams of revenge. Can an adorable newcomer help her destroy her enemies — without destroying her humanity?

episodes_data.title: Love, Death & Robots Season 4 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Are they gods? Are they giants? All this band of survivors knows is that they're deadly — and they'll have to set aside their own turf war to stop them.

episodes_data.title: Love, Death & Robots Season 4 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: This furry revolutionary has plans for world domination. All he needs is a henchman with opposable thumbs.

episodes_data.title: Love, Death & Robots Season 4 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: A mysterious race of aquatic aliens has arrived on Earth. They don't want to be taken to our leaders.

episodes_data.title: Love, Death & Robots Season 4 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: In an orbital arena, gladiators and dinosaurs compete in a deadly race — and face a terrifying new opponent.

episodes_data.title: Love, Death & Robots Season 4 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: On a perilous mission into hostile territory, the crew of a World War II bomber encounters an unholy enemy.

episodes_data.title: Love, Death & Robots Season 4 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: From thermostats to toothbrushes to toilets, these ultra-modern appliances have something to say about their hapless owners.

episodes_data.title: Love, Death & Robots Season 4 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: London, 1757. Satan battles a cat for the soul of a poet whose verse could give him dominion over the earth.
